name: Thistlebond
lore: A hedgehog envoy from the forest beyond town. His knotted ribbons bind promises, not prisoners: even a hostile creature can lend the Crossroads eight precious seconds.

primary.name: Pact Needle
primary.description: Send a traveling green needle that marks the first enemy it hits for 4 seconds. Marks guide Gathering Knot and your converted ally.

secondary.name: Gathering Knot
secondary.description: Aim at ground. A glowing knot winds up for 0.45 seconds, then draws marked enemies within 240 reach toward it, dealing 24 damage and slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Bosses take damage and slow but cannot be pulled.

special.name: Change of Heart
special.description: Turn a visible non-boss enemy into an ally for 8 seconds, or until defeated. It keeps its appearance and melee/ranged role, with up to 90 health and balanced attacks. One ally at a time. Conversion grants normal defeat rewards once and counts toward clearing the room; expiry gives no further XP. Cannot convert players or training targets.

passive: Binding Thorns: when at least two living enemies bear your Pact Needle marks, each is poisoned for 2 damage per second for 5 seconds. A lone mark does not apply poison.

technique.name: Long Pact
technique.description: Pact Needle reaches 40% farther, for 20% less damage.

final_technique.name: Bramble Fan
final_technique.description: Sweep a close bramble fan, hitting each enemy once for 30 with mild poison. Replaces Gathering Knot: no gathering, so conversion needs manual setup.

attack.name: Bramble Fan
attack.description: Sweep a close bramble fan, hitting each enemy once for 30 with mild poison. Replaces Gathering Knot: no gathering, so conversion needs manual setup.
